## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmed by weak sector breadth and a major divergence across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL and others). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Discretionary lead: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +15.07%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing strength: EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND. Select Financials: COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology weak: NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND. Energy weak: VLO (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -1.92% | 1M: -0.69%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate lagging at sector level (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -0.20%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +16.47%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Technology.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Upside momentum: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND. Downside momentum: NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND. Major divergence present (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL mixed timeframes) — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is under pressure with concentrated weakness: NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND; Tech breadth poor (approx. low-single digits positive).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed within Financials: COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +3.21%) CORRECTION — sector shows pockets of strength but not broad 1W confirmation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Split dynamics: BMY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +16.47%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +2.10% | 1M: -4.58%) RECOVERY — healthcare showing selective strength but mixed near-term signals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Consumer Discretionary and Staples names showing ABOVE TREND (TSLA, EL) and selective Financials (COF, USB); reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, AMD, ORCL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat moves in megacaps as tactical until divergence resolves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +9.54%) — leadership concentrated in autos/retail. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.48% | 1M: +2.00%) and Energy (1W: -3.88% | 1M: -1.59%) given weak 1W action.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim recent 1M highs (continued BELOW TREND would signal deeper pullback). AAPL (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +1.35%) must recover 1W losses to exit CORRECTION; TSLA momentum (sustain >1W gains) would confirm cyclical participation. Monitor major-cap leadership dispersion (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL divergence) as trigger for broader allocation shifts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergence (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) combined with weak breadth — watch for trend breaks.
